title: Agent Frontmatter
description: Schema for the YAML frontmatter block of shared/agents/*.md files. Source of truth: shared/contracts/agent-frontmatter-contract.md.

name.description: kebab-case identifier; must match filename base (analyst.md -> name: analyst).

description.description: One sentence. Include PROACTIVELY when the pipeline should invoke unconditionally; include MUST for hard-required ordering.

tools.description: Comma-separated list of Claude Code tool names. Use least-privilege, and declare every capability the prompt actually uses: an agent told to produce an artifact needs Write, one told to fix source needs Edit. Bash is a write and egress channel, not a read tool. Read-only counter agents are Read, Glob, Grep with no Bash. Recognized tools: Read, Write, Edit, MultiEdit, Bash, Glob, Grep, Task, Skill, WebFetch, WebSearch.

model_tier.description: Portable model tier declaration: 'light' (read-only pattern/schema checks), 'default' (producers/refactoring), or 'heavy' (deep architecture/security). Resolved to a concrete model ID per platform at install time. If 'model' is also present, 'model' wins on Claude Code as an explicit override.

model.description: Optional explicit vendor model override (usually 'inherit'). If present alongside model_tier, 'model' wins on Claude Code. Pin to a specific claude-* id only for cost/quality tradeoffs on a specific agent.

version.description: Semver. Bump minor on behavior-relevant change (output-format refactor, tool-list change); patch on prose-only edits; major only if the agent's contract with callers breaks.

isolation.description: Optional. 'worktree' — agent runs in a temporary git worktree isolated from the main working copy. See shared/agents/developer.md for the reference use.

status.description: Lifecycle status. Absent means active. Set to 'deprecated' when the agent is superseded and kept only for backward compatibility. Pair with superseded_by.

superseded_by.description: kebab-case name of the agent or skill that replaces this one. Required when status is 'deprecated'. health-check.sh will FAIL if the referenced name does not exist.
